displayName: OCI-AI-DB-025: AI — Prompt Injection via Database Query Result
description:
Detects prompt injection payloads delivered through database query results that contaminate AI context

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — prompt injection via database query result

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_025", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%injection%') AND "value" > 0
